about.title: About Gymshark
about.description: Gymshark makes top quality performance wear to workout in. But that’s not even the half of it. They exist to unite the conditioning* community. They do that by providing the tools to help everyone become their personal best: the clothing you’ll sweat in, the content you’ll find inspiration in and the community you’ll feel you belong in. They’re a global family over 10 million strong. They say their community is ‘not united by our goals, but by the things we do to achieve them’.
about.note: *Conditioning is everything we do today to prepare for tomorrow.
